description: NVFP4-CB / FP8-CB codebook container lane: a custom out-of-tree vLLM plugin (gridbook_plugin, plugins/gridbook/; registered under quant_method 'gridbook', with the pre-rename 'prismaquant' key kept as a read alias for already-shipped artifacts) decodes the codebook schemes into NVFP4/FP8 buffers and delegates plain NVFP4/FP8/BF16 layers to stock compressed-tensors. Deliberately a MIXED container (PLAN.md decision #1, 'FP8 in every recipe'): CB rungs coexist with plain NVFP4, FP8_DYNAMIC and BF16 in one artifact. The scheme vocabulary is prismaquant-custom (NOT stock compressed-tensors, whose schemes cannot express codebooks); ships via prismaquant.export_nvfp4_cb, docs/lanes/nvfp4-cb/LAYOUT.md is the byte contract.

export_lane.detail: The lane's menu IS the CB exporter's own EXPORTABLE_FORMATS declaration -- the same set its coverage gate accepts: the CB rung families (NVFP4_CB_K12..K24 / NVFP4_CB_S13..S16 / FP8_CB_K28..K48, pinned to format_registry by test_nvfp4_cb_formats), the two stock compressed-tensors schemes the gridbook plugin delegates to vLLM (NVFP4, and FP8_E4M3 <- FP8_DYNAMIC), the verbatim FP8_SOURCE passthrough and the BF16 container passthrough. Passthroughs need no separate entry -- the exporter folds them into the constant it declares, so there is exactly one source of truth. Anything else (MXFP4/MXFP8, the weight-only A16 family, the ggml types) has neither a CB scheme nor a CT delegation, so export_cb raises `assignment contains formats the mixed CB container cannot carry` rather than silently BF16-coercing the Linear and blowing the allocated bit budget.

format_rules.detail: The nvfp4_cb container carries the two codebook families plus their native carriers. NVFP4_CB_K12..K24 (fp4/E2M1 grid, product VQ, 2.000..3.500 bpw in 0.125 steps) and NVFP4_CB_S13..S16 (fp4 sign-magnitude VQ, 2.125..2.500 bpw) decode to bit-compatible NVFP4 tiles (E2M1 codes + group-16 E4M3 scale) and feed the CUTLASS FP4 path. FP8_CB_K28..K48 (fp8/E4M3 grid, product VQ, 3.5..6.0 bpw in 0.125 steps -- every integer k, c52d04c, per-output-channel fp32 scales) fill the NVFP4->FP8 CT-menu gap and feed the stock W8A8 GEMM; K28/K32 (added 2026-07-19) are served by the SAME plugin kernels (sub-widths 7/8 <= the GEMV's 12 ceiling, type_size 112/128 both 16-aligned). Plain NVFP4 (W4A4 group-16) and FP8_DYNAMIC (W8A8) are delegated to stock compressed-tensors by the plugin; FP8_SOURCE (verbatim native-fp8 weight + 128x128 block weight_scale copy, emitted as the stock float-quantized block-fp8 CT scheme) is likewise plugin-delegated and passthrough-only (never synthesized); BF16 is the unquantized passthrough. Every rung is served only by the out-of-tree gridbook_plugin and stays research/candidate until it clears the served gold-metric gate (exact full-vocab vLLM KL-vs-BF16 + WikiText PPL) AND the prefill perf gate (INV-2, no Triton masquerade).

The nvfp4_cb container's stock compressed-tensors delegation is DENSE-ONLY today: neither export_nvfp4_cb nor the vllm_prismaquant plugin carries a stock-CT packed-MoE emission/serving path (35B first-contact, 2026-07-19 — the exporter's stock-NVFP4 global-scale pass is 2-D and the plugin's MoE method is CB-only). Packed expert stacks use CB rungs (per-expert weighted VQ, served by PrismaQuantCBMoEMethod) or the BF16 passthrough until that path is built AND serve-validated. This is a declared capability of the container, not a quality judgement on the formats.

shape_rules.detail: CB rungs pack a 256-weight superblock along the input dim (32 k-bit codewords + the scale plane, type_size = 4k + 16 fp4 / 4k fp8 bytes, integer for every k). The 256-superblock is both the byte-exactness unit and the 8-wide vector-tiling unit; a Linear with in_features % 256 != 0 has no legal CB rung (no block-32 fallback in Phase 0) and is masked back to a coarser legal rung / BF16 by the allocator. This mirrors the FormatSpec group_size=256 divisibility check exactly (double duty), just as gguf.json pins the 256-superblock k-quant/IQ shape rule.
